purpose: Full ExerciseDB-to-Involved migration scaffold. This is a review layer, not the final canonical library.
rules: Plain-language Involved display names replace raw vendor names in the UI.
Movement defines the exercise; equipment usually becomes an implementation.
Meaningful biomechanical variations remain separate canonical exercises.
ExerciseDB source IDs/names remain intact internally.
POV/version duplicates are candidates for hiding or collapsing.
No source record is deleted during migration.
